import {IERC20Metadata} from "../token/ERC20/extensions/IERC20Metadata.sol";

 * https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-4626[ERC-4626].
 */

    event Deposit(address indexed sender, address indexed owner, uint256 assets, uint256 shares);

    event Withdraw(
        address indexed sender,
        address indexed receiver,
        address indexed owner,
        uint256 assets,
        uint256 shares
    );

    /**
     * @dev Returns the address of the underlying token used for the Vault for accounting, depositing, and withdrawing.
     *
     * - MUST be an ERC-20 token contract.
     * - MUST NOT revert.
     */

    /**
     * @dev Returns the total amount of the underlying asset that is “managed” by Vault.
     *
     * - SHOULD include any compounding that occurs from yield.
     * - MUST be inclusive of any fees that are charged against assets in the Vault.
     * - MUST NOT revert.
     */

    /**
     * @dev Returns the amount of shares that the Vault would exchange for the amount of assets provided, in an ideal
     * scenario where all the conditions are met.
     *
     * - MUST NOT be inclusive of any fees that are charged against assets in the Vault.
     * - MUST NOT show any variations depending on the caller.
     * - MUST NOT reflect slippage or other on-chain conditions, when performing the actual exchange.
     * - MUST NOT revert.
     *
     * NOTE: This calculation MAY NOT reflect the “per-user” price-per-share, and instead should reflect the
     * “average-user’s” price-per-share, meaning what the average user should expect to see when exchanging to and
     * from.
     */

     * @dev Returns the amount of assets that the Vault would exchange for the amount of shares provided, in an ideal
     * scenario where all the conditions are met.
     *
     * - MUST NOT be inclusive of any fees that are charged against assets in the Vault.
     * - MUST NOT show any variations depending on the caller.
     * - MUST NOT reflect slippage or other on-chain conditions, when performing the actual exchange.
     * - MUST NOT revert.
     *
     * NOTE: This calculation MAY NOT reflect the “per-user” price-per-share, and instead should reflect the
     * “average-user’s” price-per-share, meaning what the average user should expect to see when exchanging to and

selectedFunctions.label: Aegis Start sYUSD cooldown by YUSD amount
warnings: Static deployment/source inventory only, not a fresh RPC/runtime/storage identity or execution guarantee. Balances, allowances, pauses, canonical calldata, grants and independent execution policies remain mandatory; all admitted calls require zero native value.

Ethereum sYUSD TransparentUpgradeableProxy 0xfE0ccc9942E98C963Fe6b4e5194EB6e3Baa4cb64 is currently reported by both Sourcify and explorer as implementation 0xb0c63bB1667b6e9215AEe562aF2957739B2676fE, not its initial implementation 0xd2188c292f294e5de506594a82a2fc683f27d08e. Proxy upgrades and role-controlled cooldown/fee/insurance changes remain possible.

Underlying is Ethereum YUSD at 0x4274cD7277C7bb0806Bd5FE84b9aDAE466a8DA0a, not USDC. YUSD and sYUSD use 18-decimal base units (zero vault decimals offset). Deposit/mint spend caller YUSD allowance; vault share value follows actual YUSD vault balance, rounding and donations, not a fixed 1:1 amount or guaranteed increasing rate. No admitted function provides a caller-set slippage bound or deadline. Floor rounding can mint zero shares for small positive deposits. Deployed YUSD checks owner-controlled sender/recipient blacklist status on every mint/burn/transfer, so deposits, exits and silo claims can revert under blacklist restrictions.

cooldownAssets/cooldownShares require positive input, owner == msg.sender and nonzero cooldownDuration. They immediately burn shares, transfer gross YUSD to the fixed silo and accumulate a caller-owned underlying claim. Each new cooldown resets the maturity for the entire accumulated claim; escrowed YUSD no longer earns vault-share accrual. Underlying claim storage casts to uint152, so values must fit that width; do not treat ABI uint256 as an unlimited claim balance.

unstake(receiver) releases the caller's entire accumulated silo claim after its recorded cooldownEnd, or immediately if governance has disabled cooldown; receiver must be nonzero. Initial duration is seven days and admin may set it up to 90 days or zero; current duration is not attested. There is no cancellation or partial unstake amount argument.

Current implementation withdraw/redeem support immediate unstaking even when cooldown is enabled, unlike older cooldown-only documentation. When enabled they require a configured insurance fund and charge mutable INSTANT_UNSTAKING_FEE (basis points, admin cap 10000 = 100%). withdraw assets is GROSS, so receiver receives assets minus fee; redeem returns NET assets. Inherited previewWithdraw/previewRedeem and maxWithdraw do not incorporate that net-payout fee. Zero-cooldown exits are ordinary fee-free ERC4626 paths. Existing share allowance is needed only when caller != owner.

Official app currently advertises YUSD Stake/Stake & Earn; accessing its staking page redirects unauthenticated users to sign-in. Direct sYUSD functions reviewed here have no investor-role/KYC gate, but underlying/legal eligibility and transfer behavior still apply. Primary YUSD mint/redeem onboarding is KYC-restricted and its signed-custodian order routes are deliberately not admitted. No permits, role changes, bridge/OFT, callbacks, or arbitrary executors admitted.

underlyingAndUnits.shareDecimals: Inherited cached underlying decimals plus zero ERC4626 offset; current deployed YUSD inherits ERC20 decimals() == 18.

sourceSemantics.depositMint: Ordinary inherited ERC4626 entrypoints transfer caller YUSD with allowance and mint receiver shares. Deployed sYUSD does not override deposit/mint with investor-role/KYC authorization. Inherited maxDeposit/maxMint return uint256 max, not a liquidity/executability guarantee. Directional rounding and donation-driven exchange-rate changes apply; no minShares/maxAssets/deadline arguments.
sourceSemantics.cooldown: cooldownAssets/shares require cooldownDuration >0, input>0, owner==msg.sender. They call super.withdraw/redeem directly to bypass instant fee, burn shares and transfer YUSD to fixed stored silo. New requests reset entire owner cooldownEnd to current timestamp + current global duration and accumulate uint152 assets. There is no cancellation; accumulated claim no longer tracks share accrual. Claims must fit uint152 and its checked aggregate storage arithmetic.
sourceSemantics.claim: unstake requires receiver !=0 and consumes caller entire underlyingAmount when block.timestamp >= stored cooldownEnd OR current global duration==0; resets stored end and amount and calls silo.withdraw(receiver, assets). Fixed silo allows only staking vault to withdraw; no direct user silo target admitted. Silo uses underlying transfer; caller receives only after token transfer succeeds under YUSD blacklist rules.
sourceSemantics.instantExit: withdraw/redeem override source branches on current cooldownDuration. Zero duration uses ordinary inherited ERC4626 with no instant fee. Nonzero duration requires INSURANCE_FUND nonzero, calls inherited exit with receiver address(this), charges floor(grossAssets * INSTANT_UNSTAKING_FEE /10000), transfers fee to fund then net assets to requested receiver. withdraw assets is gross and returns shares; redeem returns net assets. Inherited previewWithdraw and previewRedeem are gross and omit fee. Existing share allowance is spent if caller != owner.
sourceSemantics.governance: ADMIN_ROLE changes duration (max 90 days, zero disables), instant fee (0..10000 bps) and insurance fund. DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE administers roles/rescues non-YUSD tokens; proxy administration can upgrade implementation. Seven days/50 bps comments/defaults are not fresh runtime parameter readings. No native-value user route, opaque calldata, permit, role administration or bridge/OFT target selected.
sourceSemantics.legalAndUnderlying: YUSD root mint onboarding page requests minter access and KYC, but it is not this staking target. No primary signed mint/redeem/custodian order or rewards authorization is admitted. Deployed underlying YUSD owner-controlled blacklist checks from and to on _update; vault, silo, owner/receiver status can affect flows. No source code claim that sYUSD price never decreases is treated as a financial guarantee.

underlying.scope: Underlying transfer/decimals dependency evidence only, not an additional admitted target; no YUSD token/mint functions selected.
